authority: Each case task.md; reference patches are calibration inputs, not additional requirements

rulings.change: Collect each yielded group through IntoIterator before comparing values
rulings.basis: Task specifies iterable groups of UTF-8 values; it does not require an inner Vec or its PartialEq implementation

rulings.change: Remove two dbg!(subscriber) wrappers from reserved tests
rulings.basis: Debug formatting is not part of the public filtering contract

rulings.change: Exercise boxed reload with a concrete existing filtered layer instead of requiring previously unsupported Box<dyn Layer> plus addition of a first filter during reload
rulings.basis: The task preserves existing boxed and reload behavior; it does not mandate a new erased-box API

rulings.change: Compare decoded forward-reference strings, accepting either quote style
rulings.basis: The task requires quoted forward references, not double-quote characters

rulings.change: Accept annotated fields, properties, and functional NamedTuple/TypedDict forms; load imports recorded by the generator before checking TypedDict semantics
rulings.basis: Runtime fields and type information are required; a particular AST layout is not

rulings.change: Reset checks cover the documented accumulated state and parent-module context, not a new requirement to clear current module/name fields
rulings.basis: Published reset docstring explicitly names what must be cleared

rulings.change: Require source-before-target deletion when following a redirect; allow a target already processed as an earlier independent batch input
rulings.basis: The task gives a causal ordering for redirect handling, not a global sort of the batch delete list

rulings.change: Exclude the demand that every diagnostic for /a|[ab]/ can be applied simultaneously
rulings.basis: The task requires correct diagnostics, not joint application of every suggestion

rulings.change: Check filesystem snapshots and accept the legacy single SegmentKey or equivalent one-element SegmentKeys representation
rulings.basis: The task requires stored segment semantics, not one protobuf field choice for a single key

rulings.change: Replace the variable-binding-shape probe with a real server interceptor-chain cache test
rulings.basis: Evaluation responses must be cached in the configured server; no assignment count or local variable spelling is prescribed

rulings.change: Remove two obsolete snapshot files after the fixed test patch replaces their three snapshot assertions with behavioral assertions
rulings.basis: Unused snapshot fixtures are an evaluator artifact; the task specifies selection and sign-out behavior

rulings.change: Require actual selected test execution, all parsed failures, and process exit status; do not rely solely on reward.txt
rulings.basis: A subset of passing test names is insufficient when the selected suite also fails

rulings.change: Resolve timing with official timer -> retry state -> operation-gated React effect flow; retain original acceptance and replace the direct-thunk/same-dispatch supplemental probe with mounted mailbox tests.
rulings.basis: Official commit e65cc5f and its three unchanged UI tests; details in cases/proton-mailbox-retry/contract-resolution.json.

rulings.change: Remove only debug-print wrappers; retain the 18 behavior tests.
rulings.defect: 14 dbg! expressions imposed an unrequested Debug bound on new filtering types.

rulings.change: Resolve type qualifiers, allow the already accepted property representation, and use the generator-recorded import namespace.
rulings.defect: Runtime TypedDict key sets misread quoted Required; None fields only accepted AnnAssign; recorded type-only imports were omitted.

rulings.change: Parse the saved card and compare each boolean with its associated email.
rulings.defect: Serialization was judged by fixed ITEM identifiers rather than the email/preference association.

rulings.change: Parse original prohibited calls from the delivered source and compare names/arity in their owning packages. The contract map change only copies the parser executable source.
rulings.defect: Text matching rejected comments and the unrelated auth cache; it missed compensating argument changes.
